description: On CI the unit suite's time is the time of its git processes (about 25 ms per spawn on macos-latest, 5 ms on ubuntu-latest; 45,157 spawns in the unit selection). The fifteen files in scope exercise worktrees, the executor's salvage and resume paths, the conflict resolver and target sync against real repositories; on main at 412bed21 they take 226.3 s summed on macOS and 37.6 s on ubuntu over 320 cases and start 8,790 git processes. Several fixtures build repositories per test (test_conflict_resolver_attempt.py starts 390 git processes in setup, test_flow_default_branch_worktree.py 336, test_host_worktree_sandbox.py 286, test_target_sync.py 154). Per-test coverage shows identical line sets for: test_worktree_all_stages.py's container-credential cases across roles (seven cases), test_ledger_worktree_cleanup.py's killed-step cases (four), test_conflict_resolver_attempt.py's label-sanitising cases (four), test_target_sync.py's push-failure cases (three), test_combined_base.py (three) and test_host_worktree_sandbox.py's two executor-commit cases.
goal: Cut the git processes and summed time of the files in scope by at least 40 percent without weakening what they prove: build each fixture repository once as a read-only template and copy it per test; run a shared scenario once and keep every assertion; collapse identical-coverage parametrised cases where the parameter is data the code does not branch on (one case per distinct code path, case-specific assertions folded in). Kill-window, crash and named-incident cases are distinct behaviour and stay. Test code only. Module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: that file is never changed; a module this change touches stays within its limit, and new helper code goes into new modules rather than growing an existing one past its limit.
rationale: Expected saving at 40 percent: about 30 s off the macOS unit job, about 7 s off the ubuntu unit job and about 7 s off the workspace-survival job per pipeline run.
acceptance_criteria: The execution notes carry a before and after table per file in scope (summed test time, case count, and the number of git processes started, counted per test with a PATH shim that logs PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST), from 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress" --durations=0 --junitxml=<report>' on the same machine, median of at least three alternating runs; the summed time and the git process count of the files in scope are each at least 40 percent lower.

Every removed or merged test is listed with the surviving test that proves the same behaviour and the evidence (identical or subset line coverage from a per-test coverage context run, plus the assertion it carried now made by the surviving test). No test that guards a distinct behaviour is removed: a test named for a regression, an incident or an edge case is kept or its assertion is folded into a surviving test, never dropped.
Line and branch coverage of the production modules the files in scope exercise, measured before and after with 'uv run pytest --cov', do not fall.
No file under apps/sandbox-executor/src is changed.
Module line budgets: holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged and no touched module exceeds its limit.

The whole unit selection passes with 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"', the files in scope also pass serially with '-p no:xdist' (no order dependence from shared fixtures), and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
